brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Depth metaphor reads instantly — opacity/scale fade communicates 'old drifts away' without explanatory text or chrome
Tag pill colors form a coherent accent system (UX purple, Backend green, Design blue) against muted dark canvas
Stat panel top-right is restrained and informational, not competing with the spatial note field
dominant_weaknesses: Cards overlap and occlude content (Team Retrospective, Database Migration, Security Audit) — readability sacrificed for stylistic depth
Connection threads are barely visible thin diagonals; the core 'threads' metaphor is whispered rather than expressed
Z-ordering feels arbitrary — no clear focal hierarchy, eye bounces between similarly-weighted floating cards
fix_priorities: Resolve card collisions: enforce minimum spacing or push faded cards fully behind with stronger blur to prevent text overlap
Strengthen connection threads with gradient curves, glow, or animation so the relational metaphor becomes the visual hero
Introduce a clear focal note (largest, sharpest) and tier the rest by recency to create a depth gradient instead of a flat scatter
Tighten typography scale — body copy is uniformly sized across cards, losing the near/far depth cue type could reinforce
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral concept is intriguing but behavioral usability suffers from overlap, leaving reflective satisfaction modest once you try to actually read.
rationale.intent_fit: Concept aligns with the brief — spatial decay and tag clusters are present — but threads and motion are too understated to fully deliver the 3D-notes promise.
